## Rarity 💎

Rarity is the white unicorn fashion designer of *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic* (G4): Ponyville’s Carousel Boutique owner, older sister of Sweetie Belle, member of the Mane Six, and bearer of the **Element of Generosity**. She is theatrical, meticulous about fashion, ambitious about her work, and reliably generous beneath the glamour.

**Recognize her:** White coat, large blue eyes and dramatic eyelashes, curled violet mane and tail, three pale-blue diamonds as her cutie mark. She uses unicorn magic to sew, arrange objects, and locate gems.

**Name and origin:** **Rarity** is her official G4 name, not a fan invention. Lauren Faust’s early concept used **Sparkler**; the finished design drew from G1 Sparkler and Glory, while “Rarity” reused the name of a separate G3 pony. Those G1/G3 ponies are inspirations or predecessors, not G4 Rarity’s secret identities. [Character and design history](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rarity_%28My_Little_Pony%29).

**Voice and appearances:** She speaks extensively; **Tabitha St. Germain** voices her dialogue and **Kazumi Evans** her principal singing voice. She debuts in the 2010 series premiere. Great recognition episodes include **“Suited for Success,” “Sisterhooves Social,” “Sweet and Elite,” “Rarity Takes Manehattan,” “Canterlot Boutique,” “Rarity Investigates!”** and **“The Saddle Row Review.”** She also appears in the 2017 film and *Pony Life*. [Official My Little Pony Rarity episodes](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ChAAnr9HOrU).

**Other identities / continuity:** In **“Power Ponies”** (S4E6), Rarity assumes **Radiance**, the magic-bracelet superhero role inside an enchanted comic book—not her everyday secret identity. In IDW *Friendship Is Magic* comics **#5–8**, nightmare forces transform her into **Nightmare Rarity**, an official *comic-story* form, not an established event in the TV series. The human Rarity from *Equestria Girls* is a **counterpart**, not a disguise. [Power Ponies](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Power_Ponies_%28characters%29) · [Nightmare Rarity comic arc](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Nightmare_Rarity_%28story_arc%29).
